command:
# #36/#39 make loadbench on Graviton: load-path and whole-process wall of upstream kraken2 at the
# pin and of our ladder builds (scripts/loadbench.ladder, last line = the launch commit),
# Standard-8, 8 threads (= vCPUs, both implementations), cold (ak2_drop_caches before every cold
# rung; 3 repetitions, after one unrecorded cold warm-up run) and warm (10 repetitions)
# (implementation order rotating per repetition), plus the profiling mode (perf stat; pprof and
# gctrace of ours) for upstream, base and final. Cheapest rung first: the empty input (load
# only) before the paired sample.
# Storage: with instance-store NVMe (r8gd/c8gd), the database and reads are staged onto it, so
# cold rungs measure the load path; otherwise (m7g) they sit on the EBS root volume, whose
# throughput caps every cold rung (the summary states the measured rate).
# Code: the launch commit (the short sha ending AK2_RUN_ID), cloned from GitHub. Database and
# reads: the in-region copies declared in AK2_DATASETS, each file checked against its sha256.
# Every setup step fails fast; the bench streams runs.tsv after every rung.
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
set -- $AK2_DATASETS
U=${1#s3://}; B=${U%%/*}; K=${U#*/}; DATA=${K%/*/*}
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
hex64() { [[ $1 =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; }

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git gcc-c++ make zlib-devel perl jq bzip2 gzip tar findutils diffutils python3 perf xfsprogs > "$W/dnf.log" 2>&1 \
  || { tail -20 "$W/dnf.log"; fail "dnf install failed"; }
ak2_say "dnf ok ($(gcc --version | head -1); $(perf --version 2>&1 | head -1))"
ak2_say "thp enabled=[$(cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled)] defrag=[$(cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/defrag)] kernel=$(uname -r) nproc=$(nproc)"
ak2_say "disks: $(lsblk -dno NAME,SIZE,MODEL,SERIAL 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ';')"
NV=$(lsblk -dpno NAME,MODEL | awk '/Instance Storage/{print $1; exit}')
if [ -n "$NV" ]; then
  sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f -q "$NV" || fail "mkfs.xfs $NV failed"
  sudo -n mkdir -p /mnt/nvme && sudo -n mount -o noatime "$NV" /mnt/nvme || fail "mount $NV failed"
  sudo -n chmod 1777 /mnt/nvme || fail "chmod /mnt/nvme failed"
  DBROOT=/mnt/nvme/db; RD=/mnt/nvme/reads
  ak2_say "storage: instance-store NVMe $NV ($(lsblk -dno SIZE,MODEL "$NV")) mounted at /mnt/nvme"
else
  DBROOT=$W/repo/.cache/db; RD=$W/repo/.cache/reads
  ak2_say "storage: no instance store; database on the EBS root volume"
fi
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
ak2_say "checkout $SHA head=$(git -C "$W/repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
GOV=$(awk '$1=="go"{print $2}' "$W/repo/go.mod")
curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 "https://go.dev/dl/go$GOV.linux-arm64.tar.gz" -o "$W/go.tgz" || fail "Go download failed"
tar -xzf "$W/go.tgz" -C "$W" || fail "Go unpack failed"
export PATH="$W/go/bin:$PATH"
go version > /dev/null || fail "no Go toolchain"
ak2_say "go: $(go version)"

# check_obj FILE KEY: FILE is non-empty and its sha256 equals the object's sha256 metadata.
check_obj() {
  local f=$1 key=$2 s want got
  s=$(stat -c%s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  # aws s3 cp: one GET below the 8 MiB multipart threshold, else 8 MiB ranged GETs.
  ak2_req GetObject $(( s < 8388608 ? 1 : (s + 8388607) / 8388608 )) "$B"
  want=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$B" --key "$key" --query Metadata.sha256 --output text)
  ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$B"
  got=$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  ak2_say "staged $key bytes=$s sha256=$got object-metadata=$want"
  hex64 "$want" && hex64 "$got" && [ "$got" = "$want" ] && [ "$s" -gt 0 ] \
    || fail "$key does not match its sha256 metadata (or is empty)"
}

ak2_phase fetch
NAME=k2_standard_08_GB_20260626
P="$DATA/$NAME"; DB="$DBROOT/$NAME"
mkdir -p "$DB" || fail "mkdir $DB failed"
ak2_stage "s3://$B/$P/" "$DB/" || fail "stage of $NAME failed"
ak2_req ListObjectsV2 1 "$B"
for f in hash.k2d opts.k2d taxo.k2d SOURCE; do check_obj "$DB/$f" "$P/$f"; done
echo "staged_from s3://$B/$P/ $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> "$DB/SOURCE"
mkdir -p "$RD" || fail "mkdir $RD failed"
r=SRR062634
for f in "${r}_200000.SOURCE" "${r}_200000_1.fq" "${r}_200000_2.fq"; do
  ak2_stage "s3://$B/$DATA/reads/$f" "$RD/$f" || fail "stage of reads/$f failed"
  check_obj "$RD/$f" "$DATA/reads/$f"
done
for m in 1 2; do
  f="${r}_200000_$m.fq"
  h=$(sha256sum "$RD/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  grep -qx "sha256 $h $f" "$RD/${r}_200000.SOURCE" || fail "$f does not match ${r}_200000.SOURCE"
done
ak2_say "reads $r verified against SOURCE"

ak2_phase build
cd "$W/repo" || fail "no repo"
scripts/oracle-build.sh > "$W/oracle-build.out" 2>&1 || { tail -30 "$W/oracle-build.out"; fail "oracle-build failed"; }
ak2_say "oracle-build ok: $(tail -1 "$W/oracle-build.out")"
make build > "$W/make-build.out" 2>&1 || { tail -30 "$W/make-build.out"; fail "make build failed"; }
ak2_say "make build ok"

# Sourced, so cold rungs use ak2_drop_caches, every rung is an ak2_phase and runs.tsv streams.
LB_DB=$DB LB_READS=$RD LB_THREADS=8 LB_REPS_COLD=3 LB_REPS_WARM=10 LB_WARMUP=1 LB_STATES="cold warm" LB_INPUTS="empty pe" \
  LB_IMPLS=upstream LB_LADDER=scripts/loadbench.ladder LB_PROFILE=1 \
  LB_PROFILE_IMPLS="upstream base final" LB_GATE=g2
export LB_DB LB_READS LB_THREADS LB_REPS_COLD LB_REPS_WARM LB_WARMUP LB_STATES LB_INPUTS LB_IMPLS LB_LADDER LB_PROFILE LB_PROFILE_IMPLS LB_GATE
. scripts/loadbench.sh
RC=$?
ak2_say "loadbench rc=$RC"
ak2_phase push
[ "$RC" != 0 ] && exit "$RC"
exit 0
